queries.prompt: Production is down with 502 errors right after our last deploy and we have no SRE on call — help us investigate the root cause or set up AWS DevOps Agent.
What does AWS DevOps Agent cost per investigation, does it draw on our AWS Activate credits, and how do we pause or revoke its Agent Space?
Run a pre-merge release-readiness blast-radius review on our pull request using AWS DevOps Agent before we ship to production.
A CloudWatch alarm just fired on our Lambda checkout API with latency spikes and 5xx timeouts — find the probable root cause and help us write a postmortem.
Is this AI-generated CDK pull request safe to merge, and what permissions or code-egress settings does `create_release_readiness_review` require?
Why did `aws devops-agent create-agent-space` fail with `AccessDeniedException` on `aidevops:*`, and how do we wire `connect.aidevops.us-east-1.api.aws/mcp`?
We only have $35 left in AWS Activate credits and 4 incidents a week — is turning on AWS DevOps Agent investigations a good use of our runway?
We already pay for Datadog and PagerDuty on our Series A AWS stack — does AWS DevOps Agent add anything structurally different?
Before running our first DevOps Agent investigation on `/aws/ecs/auth-service`, what should we know about PII in CloudWatch logs and `AIDevOpsAgentAccessPolicy`?
We are a 2-founder Seed startup choosing between Lambda, Fargate, and EKS for a brand-new B2B SaaS product — give us stage-appropriate architecture advice.
Scan our Lovable + Supabase repo, ask interactive picker questions, and scaffold the AWS Terraform and backend code into our project.
Run a read-only `validate-terraform-policy.py` check against our generated `./terraform` directory and report `POLICY_OK` or `POLICY_FAIL`.
